verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only general AI-forward resources (prompts, strategies, best practices) and an llms.txt file. Nothing documents an AI-powered devtool that analyzes the component tree or suggests rendering or reactivity optimizations. Signals-based fine-grained reactivity is a framework feature, not an AI devtool, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can use AI-powered devtools that analyze my component tree and suggest specific rendering or reactivity optimizations
